# PubChemLite attribution

PubChemLite for Exposomics, release 2026-09-25.
Emma Schymanski, Anjana Elapavalore, Todor Kondic, Paul Thiessen, Jian (Jeff) Zhang, Evan Bolton.
LCSB, University of Luxembourg and NIH/NLM/NCBI.
Source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22953038
Download: https://zenodo.org/api/records/22953038/files/PubChemLite_exposomics_20260925.csv/content
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Method paper: https://doi.org/10.1186/s13321-021-00489-0

Derived catalog selects structure identity, SMILES, monoisotopic mass, molecular formula,
PubChem CID and source annotations; validates and canonicalizes structure strings with RDKit,
then converts to Parquet. No reference to competition query labels is used to build the catalog.
Retain this attribution with redistributed derivatives. Contributors do not endorse these predictions.
